learnings: `sys.prefix != sys.base_prefix` detects a venv even when `activate` was never run.
Duplicate or unpinned requirements make installs non-reproducible.
`.gitignore` must cover `.venv/`, `__pycache__/` and `.env` from day one.
pitfalls: This repository itself had duplicate `pytest` lines and an ignored-but-missing `.env` rule – the doctor caught both.
